description: Inside tuple brackets, a newline before the opening bracket of an index is ignored
notes: The grammar lists Newline as a separator between tuple elements, but the prose says newlines between the brackets are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, so the newline doesn't end the element. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside tuple constructors (parseTupleCons in hclsyntax/parser.go).
